7.1.9.1 SetLogLevel
[SWS_Dlt_00701] ⌈If the Dlt command Dlt_SetLogLevel is requested, the new Log
Level shall be stored for the received tuple of DltSwcApplicationId/DltSwcCon-
textId.⌋
[SWS_Dlt_00702] ⌈If the Dlt command Dlt_SetLogLevel is requested, but the
received tuple of DltSwcApplicationId/DltSwcContextId is unknown, the Dlt
command shall be answered with DLT_E_ERROR.⌋
